answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by making every identity earn its standing from the nadir upward. A newcomer begins at the nadir with no trust and must do verifiable work sealed in a walnut-shell receipt: a small tamper-evident proof that only real effort can crack open. The receipt is grafted onto a vine of sponsorship — an established agent stakes some of its own standing on the newcomer, and the vine grows only as independent peers confirm the work. If the work proves fake, the vine is pruned, the sponsor loses standing, and the lineage falls back to the nadir.
